uncovered_share.rule: Empty harm set among cases in none of ai_no_identifiable_child, attempted_contact, and sting_no_minor, over that same set.

stings_keeping_h2_or_h3.rule: Strict sting whose harm set still contains h2 or h3. Stays in the uncovered-share base.

stings_with_another_harm.rule: Strict sting whose remaining harm is neither h2 nor h3. Stays in the base.

ai_no_identifiable_child.rule: Topic ai_csam, no h2 likeness mark, and no h1 or h2. Offense topics stay. No harm code. Out of the uncovered share.

attempted_contact.rule: Matched only by the removed meet / travel-to-meet / arrange-to-meet cues, and the harm set is empty. Out of the uncovered share.

sting_no_minor.rule: Undercover, at least one settled age role, and every settled role is decoy or claimed, with an empty harm set after h1 and h4 are cleared. Out of the uncovered share.
